answer: A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. To join, a name must pass Sanctioned tinsmith foundry charter, which works because a charter tinsmiths file after forge hearings. A farm faces 2 hours at the counter for every name, counted one by one for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. The glacier is on the docket. raven is written on the receipt. One beacon, one entry.
